content: Hackathon judging failure modes: (1) GPT-wrapper flood - judges increasingly skeptical of thin chat wrappers; differentiate via domain data/workflow depth (HackerNoon judge perspective); (2) demos held together with hardcoded data and mocked interfaces collapse under judge scrutiny (Semgrep 'AI Hackathon Effect'); (3) overlong demo = scope problem - cut features, rehearse, keep recorded backup video (JetBrains judging-table notes); (4) Nebius x NVIDIA hackathon on Devpost explicitly rewards 'complete, coherent product experience - not just a technical proof of concept'; demo video must include >=1 minute clip of working solution; judges score on quality of idea, potential impact.
